source: 2026-09-30. The 64 articletopic values are the list on mediawiki.org Help:CirrusSearch/articletopic; every one was queried live on en.wikipedia.org (list=search, hastemplate:"Good article" and "Featured article", one request each, UA lares-wiki/0.1 (https://github.com/JacobRoelandt04/Lares)) and none returned the 'Unrecognized value' warning. Family hits are the union counts (articletopic:a|b|c), not sums. Glyphs verified against the installed font's cmap.

query.note: one query per quality; topic values OR with | (articletopic:a|b|c), two articletopic keywords AND, negation with a leading -; the request may hold at most 300 chars beside articletopic and hastemplate. Every request carries the identified User-Agent 'lares-wiki/0.1 (https://github.com/JacobRoelandt04/Lares)' (the form with '(+github.com/...)' is treated as unidentified: 10 req/min and 429s); on a 429 wait for Retry-After.

doc.hits: Good + Featured article totalhits of the family's topics OR-ed (a union, not a sum), on hitsAsOf; sanity figures, not a contract.
doc.discoverExclude: articletopic values appended as negations (-articletopic:v) to every Discover query so computing and software never enter through another family; verified to work.
doc.glyph: hex codepoint in the font above; hue is a Theme token name.

discover.label: Geography
discover.note: geographical is places; the 22 region topics are an ORTHOGONAL lens (an article about a battle in Europe carries europe), so geographical is weighted to half of the family's picks
discover.lensNote: Region topics are an orthogonal lens (a battle in Europe carries europe), never a family member: the planner queries articletopic:geographical AND one random lens for variety. Verified 2026-09-30: geographical+europe GA|FA = 174.

largely the same articles as technology (75 GA + 2 FA)
web platforms next to a few early games
Turochamp only, which video-games already gives

guest.denyScope: case-insensitive substring of the title plus the first sentence of the lead; a hit rejects the candidate

queries.qualityNote: one query per quality, run separately and merged (the | inside hastemplate also ORs the two: 125 = 97 + 28 for physics, verified, but the per-quality form is the contract)

intersection.note: an AND of two articletopic keywords, the second an OR of the partners; the far side survives it (Engelbart, Hamming, Bartik, Kilburn, Caesar cipher, X + Y sorting, the Manchester machines, the early games); a free-text keyword does not ("history" alone: 112 hits led by History of Microsoft and Windows 1.0)

exact.good: articletopic:computing hastemplate:"Good article" ("history of computing" OR "computer pioneer" OR "computer scientist" OR "mainframe" OR "stored-program" OR "algorithm" OR "data structure" OR "computational complexity" OR "cipher" OR "Turing" OR "supercomputer" OR "computer architecture" OR "home computer" OR "computer graphics")
exact.featured: articletopic:computing hastemplate:"Featured article" ("history of computing" OR "computer pioneer" OR "computer scientist" OR "mainframe" OR "stored-program" OR "algorithm" OR "data structure" OR "computational complexity" OR "cipher" OR "Turing" OR "supercomputer" OR "computer architecture" OR "home computer" OR "computer graphics")

exact.good: articletopic:computing hastemplate:"Good article" ("human–computer interaction" OR "video game" OR "computer game")
exact.featured: articletopic:computing hastemplate:"Featured article" ("human–computer interaction" OR "video game" OR "computer game")

phrase.note: second tier, run when the intersections are exhausted: clause = the allow phrases double-quoted and joined by clauseJoin, filled greedily in list order to at most clauseMaxChars (CirrusSearch refuses more), one query per clause and quality; merge titles; the deny filter is then mandatory

bClass.filter: prop=pageassessments&palimit=max&titles=<up to 50 titles>: keep a page when any WikiProject class is exactly "B" (skip pages whose classes are all Start, Stub, C, List, ...)
bClass.note: third tier, only while bClassFallback is true and both tiers above are exhausted; no hastemplate, so the search returns every quality (7706 hits, 115 of them B-only, 24 GA, 1 FA, measured 2026-09-30) -- page through with srsort=random and let pageassessments choose; the deny filter applies as everywhere

guest.note: A guest, not a family: articletopic:computing is the near side (Deepen's wikipedia-cs); Discover draws only the far side -- history and pioneers, theory/algorithms/complexity, hardware history, graphics/HCI, games and culture. Held at the floor share by the planner. The pool is small (about 55 GA/FA titles after the deny filter), hence the B-class fallback.
